payload.summary: Planned the local model provider tier for GX10-hosted dispatch: a sixth first-class provider following the pi precedent, with the MoE-first hardware-matching rule and archetype trust boundary encoded as enforced config. Tier: coordinated; Gate 1 selected Approach 1 (first-class provider).

decisions.title: local is a first-class provider (D1)
decisions.rationale: Keeps local a distinct vendor for trust, routing, audit, and rate-limit policy; pi precedent reused

decisions.title: Trust boundary enforced in resolver with audited refusals (D3)
decisions.rationale: Prose gates are invisible to unattended loops; coordinator is the single decision point

decisions.title: Hardware matching as machine-checked roster metadata (D4)
decisions.rationale: GB10 is bandwidth-bound (~273 GB/s); active-parameter ceiling and dense >=30B rejection enforced at startup, not in comments

decisions.title: Health probe + concurrency cap in adapter (D5)
decisions.rationale: Structured fallback, never a hang; policy engine must not switch to a dead endpoint

next_steps: Implement wp-contracts then wp-coordinator and wp-dispatch in parallel per work-packages.yaml
